idleSub: Ngena kwithayile nganye ukuze ufunde ukuba yintoni. Kuthatha malunga neesekhondi ezingama-20.
pausedSub: Cofa okanye cinezela u-Enter ukuze uqhubeke.
emptySub: Yongeza umxholo kulo mdlalo ukuze ukwazi ukuwudlala.
copyFail: Umbhalo ukhethiwe. Wukope nge-Ctrl okanye Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Umdlalo wemephu yemibono. Hambisa umlinganiswa ungene kumbono ngamnye.
stageHow: Hamba ngokusebenzisa amaqhosha omnxeba okanye W A S D. Cinezela u-N ukuya kumbono olandelayo. Cinezela u-Escape ukumisa okwethutyana. Cinezela u-Tab ukuqhubeka. Umbhalo opheleleyo ukwakhona phantsi kwesithi Funda ungadlali.
hintKeys: Amaqhosha omnxeba okanye WASD ukuhamba. N kumbono olandelayo.
guideText: Ngena kwithayile engqabileyo ukuze ufumanise ukuba yintoni. Yonke ithayile oyichukumisayo ijoyina imephu.
